alignments.note: Anarthrous substantival construct adjective with its supplied 'He that' (rule 46), discontinuous around the supplied verb (rule 25).

Competing reading gives the word to the rectum as the recast construct relation under rule 19.
Nomen rectum with its supplied indefinite article (rule 15), discontinuous around the attributive (rule 25).
The clause's negation recast onto the object nominal as 'no' (rule 15).
Anarthrous substantival participle with its supplied 'he that' (rule 46), discontinuous around the possessive verb and article (rule 25).
The bet that makes this clause possessive carries the recasting's 'hath', exactly as 'asher bo mum is read (rule 43).
Noun with its supplied indefinite article (rule 15).
The ASV writes 'a perverse tongue' with no possessive, leaving this suffix unrendered (rule 22).

review_notes: The two 'hath's are placed differently because the second colon writes a bet that makes the clause possessive (rule 43) while the first writes only a construct chain; the competing reading for the first is named.
The suffix on leshono is unrepresented because the ASV writes 'a perverse tongue' rather than 'his'.
